description:
Join us as a Head of Financial Planning & Analysis

· Lead the organisation’s integrated Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) function, aligning strategic planning, target setting, budgeting and forecasting activities, risk appetite and financial objectives.

· You’ll provide Executive and Board committees with a clear, forward-looking view of financial and non-financial performance to enable informed decisions across the enterprise products, franchises and functions

· Take on a highly influential leadership role offering the opportunity to shape financial strategy and drive short and long-term organisational performance

· Work closely with Treasury on capital and funding plans.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will partner at the highest level in the organisation, presenting plans, forecasting and driving performance. You’ll lead the development of a consistent and integrated FP&A framework across the organisation, establishing common planning assumptions, methodologies, performance measures, data standards, models and controls. We’ll look to you to drive enterprise-wide scenario analysis, financial modelling and FP&A contributions to both internal and regulatory stress testing. You'll bring together financial, customer, operational, workforce, risk and climate insights to create a comprehensive view of actual and forecast performance across the organisation.

You’ll be:

· Providing clear, timely and decision-focused insight to Executive and Board committees, highlighting performance drivers, emerging risks, opportunities and recommended actions

· Delivering independent and constructive challenge across plans, forecasts, scenarios and investment decisions, supporting effective prioritisation and resource allocation

· Establishing clear accountabilities and effective ways of working across FP&A, finance business partners, strategic finance teams, Centres of Excellence and specialist functions

· Building and leading a high-performing, multidisciplinary team with the strategic, commercial, financial, analytical and technology capabilities required for the future

· Acting as a senior Finance leader and contributing to the wider Finance strategy, operating model and transformation agenda

The skills you'll need

We’re looking for a finance expert with significant senior leadership experience across FP&A, strategic finance, business partnering or financial management within a large and complex organisation. You'll combine deep financial expertise with a strong understanding of banking products, franchises and the key financial and non-financial drivers of performance.

You'll have highly developed commercial judgement and the ability to translate complex analysis into clear choices, recommendations and actions that influence strategic decision-making at the highest levels of the organisation.

You’ll also demonstrate:

· Extensive experience leading strategic planning, target setting, budgeting, forecasting, performance management and executive reporting in a complex environment

· Strong expertise in scenario analysis, financial modelling and stress testing, including the interplay between profit and loss, balance sheet, capital and liquidity outcomes

· A proven track record of transforming finance processes, operating models, data and technology capabilities across organisational boundaries

· The credibility to influence, challenge and advise senior executives and governance committees

· Experience leading and developing senior multidisciplinary teams through periods of significant change

· A recognised accountancy qualification, or equivalent significant professional experience
title: Head of Financial Planning & Analysis

description:
Location: Central London

Employment Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Salary: £30,000-£35,000 per annum + Performance Bonus

Working Pattern: Monday-Friday Hybrid options available

The Opportunity

We are seeking a commercially minded Graduate Business Finance Advisor to join our growing financial consultancy team, supporting UK businesses with their funding requirements and commercial decision-making.

This entry-level, client-facing position is ideal for graduates interested in understanding business operations, analysing financial information and helping businesses explore practical funding solutions.

You will work alongside experienced finance professionals, supporting commercial clients, company directors and business owners with their financing requirements.

Structured onboarding, professional development and exposure to multiple industries will help you build a successful career in commercial finance.

Previous experience is not essential, although strong analytical skills, commercial awareness and a willingness to learn are important.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Graduate Business Finance Advisor, you will support client enquiries, financial assessments and commercial finance applications under appropriate supervision.

Your responsibilities will include:
• Communicating with business owners, directors and commercial clients.
• Understanding business models, financial circumstances and commercial objectives.
• Identifying clients' funding requirements and gathering relevant information.
• Reviewing financial statements, management accounts and cash-flow information.
• Supporting senior colleagues in assessing business performance and funding options.
• Providing general information about commercial finance products and application processes.
• Supporting businesses seeking finance for expansion, equipment, working capital and acquisitions.
• Researching commercial loans, asset finance, invoice finance and other funding solutions.
• Preparing client summaries, financial reports and preliminary finance proposals.
• Liaising with lenders, finance providers and internal departments.
• Gathering documentation required for commercial finance applications.
• Comparing commercial finance terms and preparing information for client discussions.
• Monitoring application progress and maintaining accurate client records.
• Following compliance, confidentiality and data-protection procedures.
• Building professional relationships with business clients.
• Keeping informed about developments within the UK commercial finance market.

As your experience develops, you will gradually take on greater responsibility for client enquiries, financial assessments and commercial finance cases.

What We're Looking For

We welcome ambitious graduates with strong communication skills, commercial awareness and an interest in financial services.

Suitable degree disciplines include:

Finance Accounting Economics Business Management Banking Financial Analysis Corporate Finance Financial Consultancy

Essential Requirements
• A degree in finance, accounting, economics, business, banking or a related discipline.
• Strong numerical and analytical skills.
• Basic understanding of financial statements, cash flow and business performance.
• Confidence communicating with business owners and senior professionals.
• Good commercial judgement and problem-solving abilities.
• Level 4 CPD certification for financial advisers.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to explain financial information clearly and professionally.
• Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
• Professional, client-focused approach.
• Willingness to develop commercial finance knowledge.
• Interest in building a long-term career within financial services.

Previous experience through internships, university placements, banking, accountancy or financial services would be advantageous but is not essential.

What We Offer

This position combines competitive graduate earning potential with professional development and long-term career opportunities.

Benefits include:
• £30,000-£35,000 starting salary, depending on qualifications and relevant experience.
• Performance-related bonus scheme.
• Additional incentives linked to individual and team performance.
• Structured onboarding and professional training.
• Exposure to businesses across multiple industries.
• Clear progression into senior advisory and management positions.
• Hybrid working opportunities following successful onboarding.
• Company pension.
• Generous annual leave allowance.
• Regular performance and salary reviews.

Career Progression

We aim to develop graduates into confident commercial finance professionals with strong analytical, financial and client relationship skills.

As your experience grows, you will have opportunities to manage more complex finance enquiries, develop commercial relationships and take on greater responsibilities.

Typical career pathway:

Graduate Business Finance Advisor Business Finance Advisor Senior Business Finance Advisor Commercial Finance Manager Head of Business Finance

Progression depends on individual performance, professional competence and business requirements.

Important Scope of the Role

This is a business and commercial finance position, not an investment-advisory or personal wealth-management role.

The successful candidate must operate within the services and permissions applicable to Westminster Commercial Finance and must not undertake regulated activities unless appropriately authorised or exempt.

Graduates will receive supervision and professional guidance while developing their experience.

Apply Now

Are you a recent graduate looking to establish a career in commercial finance?

If you enjoy working with numbers, understanding businesses and communicating with professionals, this opportunity offers a foundation for career development within finance, consultancy and commercial strategy.

We welcome applications from ambitious graduates with strong analytical skills, commercial awareness and the motivation to succeed within the UK financial services sector.

description:
We’re looking for talented individuals who bring initiative, creativity, and curiosity to the table. In return, you’ll gain valuable hands-on experience, receive mentorship from some of the industry’s best and earn recognised professional qualification.


By the end of your Graduate Programme, you’ll be a well-rounded, commercially minded professional, ready to take on interesting and challenging responsibilities. You won’t just be fully qualified - you’ll be fully prepared to drive your own career forward.


What sets us apart


At MHA, people come first, our colleagues, our clients, and the communities we support. In 2026, we ranked as number 11 in the UK’s top accountancy firms and a proud member of Baker Tilly International, the world’s 8th largest network, we combine global insight with a strong local commitment.


Our people-centred approach is what truly makes us different. You will be welcomed as a valued member of a collaborative, purpose-led team. We are committed to continuous learning, growth, and creating an environment where everyone can thrive and be themselves.


We are proud to hold the Investors in People Gold award, recognising our commitment to supporting, developing, and valuing every individual.


Here, you’ll go beyond numbers


We are looking for a Corporate Finance Analyst to join us who is comfortable in an evolving environment and enjoys solving a variety of challenges that contribute to meaningful outcomes.


At MHA, you will be surrounded by passionate professionals who are committed to making a difference. Your work in Corporate Finance will go beyond the numbers, we believe in hands-on learning. You’ll be doing real work on real projects, not just shadowing.


While you’ll receive mentorship and guidance, we prefer you to learn through extensive and practical on-the-job training.


Corporate Finance is a varied and commercially focused career where you’ll help businesses make some of their most important decisions. You could support clients looking to buy or sell a business, raise finance, secure investment or plan the next stage of their growth. No two projects are the same, giving you the opportunity to work with a wide range of organisations, industries and people.


From an early stage, you’ll build relationships with clients and work closely with experienced colleagues across MHA. You’ll ask questions, gather financial and commercial information, research businesses and markets, and contribute to reports and presentations for clients. You’ll also develop your analytical skills and commercial awareness, helping you understand what drives a successful business and identify the information that matters.


You don’t need to arrive knowing everything. We’re looking for people who are curious, willing to learn and comfortable working collaboratively. If you enjoy understanding how businesses work and grow, analysing information, solving problems and working with different people on a variety of projects, Corporate Finance could be a great fit for you.


As a Corporate Finance Analyst, you’ll experience the power of collaboration as you work with diverse teams on real projects, build lasting connections with colleagues and start off by learning the fundamentals, including:



• Analysing financial information

• Assisting with the development and drafting of reports and business planning documentation

• Conducting detailed market research and analysis

• Attending client meetings and developing relationships

• Assisting with the efficient project management of transaction processes

• Studying towards Professional Qualification (ACA Level 7)



Rewards that resonate


You’re more than a number to us; you’re someone with unique skills and aspirations. Our benefits are designed to support your wellbeing, foster your professional growth, and recognise the contribution you make.



• Agile working: Our flexible working policy gives you greater choice over how you structure your day. With core hours of 10am–2pm, you can start earlier or finish later to suit your needs, alongside the option to work from home up to two days a week. For trainees, we ask for full office attendance during the first six months to ensure you receive the training, support and experience needed for a strong start, with greater flexibility available after that.

• 30 days’ holiday, including bank holidays, plus the opportunity to buy or sell up to 5 days (28 days on a training contract, with the opportunity to buy 5 days).

• Full study support package: including exams, tuition, study leave days and materials.

• Employee recognition awards: Performance Award bonus and other recognition initiatives.

• Employee Assistance Programme: A free, confidential 24-hour support service, including unlimited counselling sessions and access to virtual doctors for you and your family.

• And lots more!



Disability Confident


We are a Disability Confident employer. If you have a disability and meet the essential criteria for the role, we will progress you to the next stage of the process.


If you require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process to help you perform at your best, please let us know and we will be happy to help.

Job title: Wealth Transformation Graduate Department: Wealth Transformation, Wealth Management Salary: £45,000 Start date: Thursday 16 September 2027 Location: City of London, London

About Schroders, our parent company

Schroders is a global investment manager which provides active asset management, wealth management and investment solutions. We aim to provide excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We serve a diverse client base that includes pension schemes, insurance companies, sovereign wealth funds, endowments, foundations, high net worth individuals, family offices, as well as end clients through partnerships with distributors, financial advisers, and online platforms.

Established in 1804, we have around 5,500 people across 36 global locations. Schroders' success can be attributed to its diversified business model, spanning different asset classes, client types and geographies.

Programme overview:
Our two-year Wealth Transformation Graduate Programme offers a unique opportunity to gain broad experience across Business Transformation at one of the UKs leading & fastest growing wealth management business. You’ll combine on-the-job experience with structured learning and development, including taking the Investment Advisory Diploma (IAD), and opportunities to network with colleagues across the business.

As part of the programme, you will undertake rotations within Wealth Transformation, gaining hands-on experience in the roles of Business Architecture, Strategic design, Business Analysis and Project Management

Through these rotations, you will gain exposure to strategic design opportunities spanning the Wealth business, including Client teams, Investment, Operations and key support functions.

Who we are looking for

• A strong interest in the transformation of a business to improve growth, efficiency and risk outcomes

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to express ideas clearly and work effectively with a range of colleagues.

• Collaborative and relationship-oriented, building trusted connections within teams and across the organisation.

• Inquisitive and commercially aware, with a genuine interest in Wealth Management and relevant industry trends.

• Innovative, analytical and able to apply critical thinking by thinking ‘outside the box’ and applying a fresh perspective, particularly using AI.

• Proactive, organised, and eager to get involved in a broad range of tasks, projects, and teams.

• Adaptable and resilient, able to manage multiple priorities, remain composed during periods of uncertainty, and embrace new challenges.

• A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, a high attention to detail who takes the initiative and delivers high-quality work.

• A growth mindset - we understand you may make mistakes, and when you do, we are looking for you to learn from these.

• Eager to learn and develop, actively embracing feedback, pursuing professional growth, and demonstrating natural curiosity.

• Problem solver with the ability to ‘get into the detail’ whilst seeing and managing the ‘bigger picture’.

The Team

Schroders Wealth Transformation team has a remit across the transformation lifecycle from strategy to execution. We collaborate with our business and technology partners across the Schroders Group to enable our Cazenove Capital and Schroders International Wealth business to thrive in an increasingly competitive, regulated and margin pressured global landscape by shaping, mobilising and delivering both transformational and essential change to allow the business to grow profitably while providing high levels of investment performance and client experience.

What you will do

Throughout the programme, you will take an active role in a broad range of transformation projects and initiatives. You will gain exposure to and experience in the key Change roles of Business Architect, Project Manager and Business Analyst, with hands-on experience within each discipline. You will have the opportunity to contribute at all stages of the Change lifecycle, from strategy and design, to project delivery and implementation.

•
Project Management: Collaborate with project teams and business stakeholders to drive the successful delivery of change initiatives on time and within budget. Establish a critical path and deliverable plan, ensuring clarity of direction, effective communication, and disciplined project governance throughout each phase.

•
Business Analysis: Act as a bridge between business needs and solutions, working collaboratively with stakeholders to understand and articulate requirements, define target processes, and support the design and realisation of effective, value-driven change.

•
Business Architect : Contributing as a proactive team member, building knowledge of the business, strategic design, and operating model, to support the design and delivery of successful transformation projects to help solve business challenges and create sustainable value for the organisation.

Qualifications required:

• An honours degree or equivalent – we are open to all degree subjects and predicted grades

• You will be in your final year of study or have already graduated

No prior Change or Wealth Management experience is need. We just need you to bring your drive, passion and enthusiasm to make the most of the opportunity, to start building your career.
Benefits of joining us :

When you join the Wealth Transformation Graduate programme at Schroders, you will benefit from a wide range of professional and personal development opportunities, including:

• Professional qualifications: Achieve the Investment Advice Diploma (IAD) in your first few weeks - the UK’s benchmark entry qualification for investment professionals Opportunity to complete further qualifications related to your role

• Comprehensive training: Access immersive training sessions covering industry knowledge, technical skills, and essential soft skills to help you adapt, thrive, and make an impact from day one

• Senior networking opportunities: Attend exclusive “Coffee Hours” hosted by senior leaders, allowing you to build your network within the industry

• Buddy system: Be paired with a dedicated buddy to support your transition into both the programme and the wider business

• Wellbeing support: Access to our Employee Assistance Programme, offering 24-hour confidential counselling and resources on a range of topics, including mental health Use of a private GP service

• On-site facilities: Enjoy the convenience of an on-site staff restaurant and complimentary use of our on-site gym

By joining us, you will be part of an inclusive environment where your learning, wellbeing, and professional growth are a priority.
Recruitment process:

• Online application form

• Stage 1 Cognitive Online Assessment

• Stage 2 Behavioural and Motivational Assessment

• Stage 3 Work Simulation and Video Interview

• Assessment centre

Candidates should be available to start the Wealth Transformation Graduate programme on Thursday 16 September 2027.

We Recognise Potential, Whoever You Are Our purpose is to deliver excellent investment performance to clients through active management. We believe diverse perspectives and an inclusive culture help us make better decisions and achieve better outcomes for our clients. That's why inclusion is a strategic priority for us, and we are an equal opportunities employer. You are welcome here, regardless of your age, disability, gender identity, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, socio-economic background, or any other protected characteristic.

We will consider flexible working arrangements for all roles and provide reasonable accommodations to support applicants and employees, including those with neurodiversity, disability, or physical and mental health needs. For more information, please visit our FAQs.

description:
What's Your Possible?

Take on a role where your ideas, analytical mindset and ambition can make a real difference, helping shape a secure and evolving energy future.

As a Finance & Management Reporting Graduate, you'll support the analysis, reporting and forecasting activities that help business leaders understand performance, identify opportunities and make informed decisions. You'll gain exposure to management reporting, financial modelling, scenario analysis and trading performance evaluation while working closely with colleagues across Finance, Commercial and Technology teams.

This is an excellent opportunity for graduates who enjoy working with data, solving complex business challenges and understanding the financial drivers behind commercial performance. You'll develop both technical finance expertise and valuable commercial awareness within a dynamic global energy business.

What Will You Do?

• Produce financial analysis and management reporting that supports decision-making across the business.

• Assist in the preparation of monthly and quarterly reporting packs, dashboards and key performance indicators for senior stakeholders.

• Analyse business performance by investigating variances, identifying trends and highlighting key commercial drivers.

• Support the development of financial models, including cost of capital (WACC) calculations, valuation activities and sensitivity analysis.

• Contribute to scenario planning exercises by modelling the financial impact of market, regulatory and economic changes.

• Analyse trading performance data to provide insights into margins, market movements and business results.

• Work with SAP S/4HANA and SAP Analytics Cloud to extract, validate and interpret financial and operational data.

• Collaborate with colleagues across Finance, Technology and Business Intelligence teams to improve reporting processes, automation and data quality.

• Take ownership of your professional development, building technical, analytical and commercial skills throughout the programme.

What Will You Bring?

We're looking for curious and analytical graduates who enjoy working with data, understanding business performance and turning information into meaningful insights. You'll be naturally detail-oriented, eager to learn and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where collaboration and problem-solving are key.

You’ll Ideally Have

• A degree (completed or due to be completed before the programme starts) in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Data Analytics, Mathematics, Business or a related discipline.

• Strong analytical and numerical skills, with the ability to interpret data, identify meaningful business insights and support decision-making.

• Excellent attention to detail, organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities while delivering accurate, high-quality work.

• Excellent communication skills, with the confidence to present findings and recommendations clearly to a variety of stakeholders.

• The ability to build strong working relationships and collaborate effectively across different teams and functions.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, with an interest in developing advanced analytical, financial modelling and reporting skills.

• An interest in corporate finance, financial planning, valuation, performance reporting and business analysis.

• A proactive approach, willingness to learn and ability to work independently when required. Knowledge of SAP, SAP HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud or other reporting and analytics platforms would be advantageous but is not essential.

About Us

Full job description

Graduate ESG Analyst

Location: City of London
• Performance Bonus Scheme
• Annual ESG Excellence Award
• International Travel Opportunities
• Hybrid Working Options
• Pension Scheme
• 25 Days Annual Leave Plus Bank Holidays
• Global Mobility Opportunities
• Visa Sponsorship Available for Exceptional Candidates Meeting Eligibility Requirements

Launch Your Career in Sustainable Finance

A leading international investment and advisory organisation is seeking ambitious and forward thinking individuals to join its Environmental, Social and Governance division at its London headquarters.

With operations spanning Europe, Asia, North America and the Middle East, this organisation advises major corporations, institutional investors, infrastructure projects and global investment funds on sustainability strategy, responsible investment practices and long term value creation.

This opportunity has been specifically designed for graduates and early career professionals who are passionate about sustainability, climate initiatives, corporate responsibility and the future of global business.

Working alongside experienced ESG specialists, investment professionals and sustainability consultants, you will gain exposure to real world projects from day one while developing expertise in one of the fastest growing sectors within financial services.
What You Will Be Doing
• Conducting ESG research across listed companies, industries and global markets
• Analysing sustainability data and identifying key trends affecting investment decisions
• Supporting the preparation of ESG reports, presentations and client recommendations
• Monitoring environmental regulations, governance developments and emerging sustainability frameworks
• Assisting senior analysts with due diligence projects and responsible investment assessments
• Evaluating climate related risks and opportunities impacting organisations worldwide
• Contributing to corporate sustainability initiatives and stakeholder engagement projects
• Supporting international teams on ESG assignments across multiple jurisdictions
What We Are Looking For
• A degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Sustainability, Environmental Science, Geography, Politics or a related discipline
• Strong analytical and problem solving abilities
• Excellent communication and report writing skills
• A genuine interest in sustainability, responsible investing and corporate governance
• The ability to interpret information and present findings clearly
• Strong attention to detail and organisational skills
• A positive attitude and willingness to learn in a fast paced professional environment
What Makes This Opportunity Different

Unlike many graduate programmes, successful candidates will work directly on meaningful projects from the outset rather than spending months in purely administrative roles.

You will have the opportunity to collaborate with international teams, contribute to sustainability initiatives that influence major investment decisions and build expertise in a field that is becoming increasingly important to organisations worldwide.
• Graduate ESG Analyst
• ESG Analyst
• Senior ESG Analyst
• ESG Manager
• Director of Sustainability & Responsible Investment

This position offers an outstanding platform for ambitious graduates looking to combine commercial success with positive global impact while building a rewarding long term career within sustainable finance and international business.
